capabilities: discover installed Chrome, Chromium, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Arc, Firefox and Safari profiles
import each bookmark as a Markdown note rendered from a template
mirror the browser folder tree into vault subfolders or a flat folder
filter syncing to a chosen root browser folder
run syncs on demand, on startup, or at periodic intervals with URL-based duplicate handling
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not sync Obsidian's own Bookmarks core feature; it imports web-browser bookmarks as notes.
extras: Desktop-only (macOS, Windows, Linux) because it reads browser database files outside the vault; fully offline with no network requests or telemetry. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Safari access requires either a per-session file-pick or macOS Full Disk Access.
problem: Obsidian has no way to bring browser bookmarks into the vault as notes, so saved links stay separate from research and writing.

relations.evidence: Automatically discover installed Chrome, Chromium, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Arc, Firefox, Firefox Developer Edition, and Safari (macOS) profiles.
Reads live bookmarks from places.sqlite with the SQLite module built into Obsidian

requires.name: a desktop browser with saved bookmarks (Chrome, Chromium, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Arc, Firefox, or Safari on macOS)

summary: Imports bookmarks from Chrome, Firefox, Safari and other Chromium browsers as individual Markdown notes using customizable templates.
